question: What is the advance tax on the transport sector and why was it introduced?
answer: It simplifies tax payment for transport operators, raises revenue for road construction and maintenance, and widens the tax base. It is collected on motorcycles, passenger vehicles (PSVs/buses), and goods or freight vehicles with loading capacity above 2 tonnes.

question: Which vehicles must pay and who is responsible?
answer: Owners of motorcycles, passenger vehicles, and goods/freight vehicles above 2 tonnes must pay. The vehicle owner is solely responsible for paying the advance income tax.

question: How do I determine the loading capacity for goods vehicles?
answer: Use the logbook values: loading capacity = gross weight – net weight.

question: How much advance tax do I pay by vehicle type?
answer: Goods vehicles above 2 tonnes: UGX 50,000 per tonne of loading capacity per year. Trailers: UGX 50,000 per tonne per year. Passenger vehicles (PSVs) and buses: UGX 20,000 per passenger seat per year. Motorcycles (boda boda): UGX 20,000 per year (licensed to carry one passenger).

question: Example: How is advance tax computed for a 7-tonne goods vehicle?
answer: Multiply loading capacity by the rate: 7 tonnes × 50,000 = UGX 350,000 per year.

question: Example: How is advance tax computed for a 14-seat omnibus?
answer: Multiply seats by the passenger rate: 14 seats × 20,000 = UGX 280,000 per year.

question: Example: How is advance tax computed for a 67-seat bus?
answer: Multiply seats by the passenger rate: 67 × 20,000 = UGX 1,340,000 per year.

question: How much does a boda boda pay?
answer: A motorcycle licensed to carry one person pays UGX 20,000 per year as advance income tax.

question: How do I pay the advance tax?
answer: Steps: 1) Go to the URA website and choose Make a payment. 2) Click “Click here to make a payment.” 3) Select taxpayer details and enter vehicle details. 4) Select Tax Head → Advance Tax for Motor vehicles. 5) Enter payment details, choose mode (e.g., mobile money), complete the captcha, and submit to generate the payment slip.

question: How is the advance tax treated when filing income tax returns?
answer: When filing your income tax return, deduct the advance income tax paid from the tax payable (it offsets your final income tax).

question: What is the statutory procedure for official motor vehicle registration in Uganda?
answer: To register a motor vehicle: 1) Login to the URA web portal at ura.go.ug with your TIN; 2) Go to e-Services -> Motor Vehicle Registration; 3) Fill in the registration form with chassis, engine, and vehicle details; 4) Upload required documents: customs declaration, commercial invoice, bill of lading, and export logbook; 5) Generate a Payment Registration Number (PRN) and pay statutory registration fees; 6) Undergo physical inspection at the URA licensing office; 7) Receive number plates and digital logbook.

question: How do I transfer ownership of a motor vehicle or motorcycle to a new owner?
answer: To transfer vehicle ownership: 1) Both buyer and seller must have valid TINs; 2) Seller initiates a Motor Vehicle Transfer on the URA web portal (ura.go.ug); 3) Upload signed transfer form, photo IDs/NINs, and original logbook; 4) Generate PRN for the statutory transfer fee of UGX 100,000 plus stamp duty of 1% on vehicle market value; 5) Pay via bank or mobile money; 6) Undergo physical verification; 7) URA issues the transferred logbook in the buyer's name.

question: What is the Environmental Levy on imported used motor vehicles?
answer: Under Section 13 of the Excise Duty Act 2014 as amended, imported used motor vehicles are subject to an Environmental Levy based on age from year of manufacture: 1) Vehicles aged below 5 years: 0% (Nil); 2) Vehicles aged 5 to 8 years: 35% of customs CIF value; 3) Vehicles aged exceeding 8 years: 50% of customs CIF value. Commercial goods trucks and tractors are exempt.

question: What are the fees for replacing a lost motor vehicle logbook?
answer: To replace a lost logbook: 1) Obtain a police report of loss; 2) Make a sworn affidavit of loss; 3) Publish a notice of loss in a national newspaper; 4) Apply online on the URA portal (ura.go.ug) under Motor Vehicle -> Duplicate Logbook; 5) Pay the statutory replacement fee of UGX 50,000 via PRN; 6) Collect the duplicate logbook after verification.

question: What are the statutory fees for personalized or vanity number plates in Uganda?
answer: Under Traffic and Road Safety regulations, personalized or vanity registration plates require a statutory fee of UGX 20,000,000. Standard registration plates require UGX 1,500,000 for motor vehicles and UGX 750,000 for motorcycles.

question: Gharama ya nambari maalum ya usajili wa gari (vanity plate) nchini Uganda ni kiasi gani?
answer: Gharama ya kisheria ya nambari maalum ya usajili wa gari (personalized au vanity number plate) nchini Uganda ni Shs 20,000,000 chini ya kanuni za Usalama Barabarani. Nambari za kawaida za gari ni Shs 1,500,000 na pikipiki ni Shs 750,000.

question: Ennamba z'emmotoka ez'enjawulo (personalized plates) zisasulirwa ssente mmeka mu Uganda?
answer: Ennamba z'emmotoka ez'enjawulo era ez'obwengula (personalized plates) zisasulirwa omusolo gwa gavumenti ogwa ssente obukadde amakumi abiri (UGX 20,000,000). Ennamba ezabbuliwo za ssente 1,500,000 ku mmotoka ne ssente 750,000 ku pikipiki.

question: Biwandiiko ki ebyetaagisa okuyisa emmotoka mu forodha?
answer: Ebiwandiiko ebyetaagisa okuyisa emmotoka mu forodha kuliko: 1) Bill of Lading oba Airway Bill; 2) Invoysi y'obusuubuzi (Commercial Invoice); 3) Kaada oba yinsuwa y'emmotoka; 4) Ebaluwa y'okugifulumya (Export Certificate); 5) Ekiwandiiko ekiraga omuwendo gwa CIF; 6) Foomu ya forodha ey'okwanjula (Customs Declaration).

question: Nyaraka gani zinahitajika kusafisha gari lililoagizwa katika forodha?
answer: Nyaraka zinazohitajika kusafisha gari katika forodha ni: 1) Bill of Lading; 2) Ankara ya kibiashara (Commercial Invoice); 3) Cheti cha kusafirisha nje (Export Certificate); 4) Bima ya usafirishaji; 5) Hati ya uthamini ya CIF; 6) Fomu ya tamko la forodha (Customs Declaration).

question: How is the number plate and motor vehicle registration fee paid in Uganda?
answer: To pay motor vehicle registration fees and number plate fees in Uganda: 1) Generate a Payment Registration Number (PRN) on the URA web portal (ura.go.ug) under e-Services > Motor Vehicle Registration; 2) Take the PRN to any commercial bank or pay via mobile money / bank agent; 3) Once payment reflects, present the receipt and vehicle for inspection at URA Nakawa to receive the registration plates.

question: Je, ada ya nambari ya usajili na usajili wa gari inalipwaje nchini Uganda?
answer: Ili kulipa ada ya usajili wa gari na nambari ya gari nchini Uganda: 1) Tengeneza nambari ya malipo ya PRN (Payment Registration Number) kupitia tovuti ya URA (ura.go.ug); 2) Lipa ada hiyo kupitia benki yoyote ya biashara au kupitia pesa za simu (mobile money); 3) Peana stakabadhi na gari lako kwa ukaguzi Makao Makuu ya URA Nakawa ili upokee nambari yako ya usajili.

question: Are commercial cargo trucks exempt from the Environmental Levy?
answer: Yes. Under Section 13 of the Excise Duty Act 2014 as amended, commercial goods vehicles including cargo trucks, lorries, pickups, prime movers, and agricultural tractors are specifically exempt from the Environmental Levy regardless of their age.

question: Je, malori ya mizigo yamesamehewa tozo ya mazingira?
answer: Ndiyo. Chini ya Kifungu cha 13 cha Sheria ya Ushuru wa Bidhaa (Excise Duty Act), magari ya kibiashara ya kubeba mizigo (malori, matrekta, na pickups) yamesamehewa tozo ya mazingira (Environmental Levy) bila kujali umri wake.

question: Lole n'ebimmotoka eby'ebyamaguzi bikolereddwa ku musolo gw'obutonde?
answer: Yee. Wansi w'Ekitundu 13 eky'Etteeka ly'Omusolo gw'Ebikolebwa (Excise Duty Act), ebyentambula by'ebyamaguzi eby'obusuubuzi (lole, tulakita, n'ebimmotoka ebinene) byasonyiyibwa omusolo gw'obutonde (Environmental Levy) ka bibe nga bikaddiye kyenkanaki.
